changelog: v1.0.6: probe-truth hardening — on some devices (vivo/Android 17) the cmd/dumpsys probes intermittently return nothing seconds after a healthy run, which used to render as a scary false 'GMS not installed'. check.sh now verifies the probe channel itself and reports probe:0 in the JSON when dumpsys didn't answer; the WebUI then shows amber '探测失败(结果不可信)' rows instead of red false alarms, and the human report labels those lines 探测失败 rather than 未安装. pkg-installed probing falls back from 'cmd package path' to 'pm path' so a transient binder hiccup can't read as uninstalled. The console now also shows stderr lines (warnings were invisible before) and strips ANSI color codes, so the 📋 copied diagnostic log is clean text. v1.0.5: one-tap diagnostic report copy. v1.0.4: friendly guidance UX (Safe-mode banner/popup/steps). v1.0.3: dead-bridge read-only mode. v1.0.2: universal bridge adapter. v1.0.1: absolute moduleDir paths. v1.0.0: initial release — GMS stopped-state detection & unstop (Android 13+), triple GCM heartbeat, per-boot one-shot auto recovery, target manager, vivo deep links, offline WebUI. Requires Full access + Allow background actions, shell uid 2000 only.
